posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
so you'll see it says smoething like [[include cdref]] (for Citizen Dawn for instance) - all you have to do is at your address bar go to 

 

sotm.wikidot.com/cdref

 

That will take you to the individual page. You can edit it from there.

 

The reason for the includes is so they can also be included on the Hero/Villain page and only require being updated in one place no matter how many places we want to use them. So if you want to look at them all, you go to the reference page. If you just want Citizen dawn info you get the same info ion her page without me having to police multiple pages :)

posts.cooked:
I was looking through the list, and I remembered something.

Does anyone else remember what threadwe discussed the girl from Blighted Streets and her being the same from Vigilence and I suggested she could be the girl from the Sentinels?  I believe Christopher confirmed that they were the same girl, that she wasn't from the sentinels, and that that girl would have a bigger part to play in he future.  I looked for the last 20 minutes and couldn't find it, I thought it was Phantom's speculation thread but it was not.

 

Does anyone else remember that?  I could be going crazy but if not that would be cool info for the references page.
